verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Secureframe publishes its own MCP server, which external clients such as Claude Code or Cursor connect to. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing shows Secureframe's Comply AI or any other feature can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. For a SaaS platform with built-in AI features this is a plausible capability, so the axis applies and the answer is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
